## The mandate, verbatim

```
# policy: ingress-class
# version: v3   effective: 2026-04-19   status: current
# subject: which ingress implementation new services must use
apiVersion: policy.meridian.io/v1
kind: FleetPolicy
metadata:
  name: ingress-class-v3
spec:
  effectiveFrom: 2026-04-19
  status: current
  setting: gateway-api
```

## What the mode means

`100755` is a regular file (`100`) with the owner-execute bit set (`755`). Git only records two modes for regular files — `100644` (not executable) and `100755` (executable) — so this file is checked out with the execute bit and can be run directly.
